name: daily-journal
description: Brazilian and world news in Portuguese, with every story cited to its original outlets (Folha, G1, BBC, FT, NYT, Bloomberg and more). Search the news, open a story with all its sources, get the full background on an ongoing story, or read official figures: the 2026 election results, who sits in Congress, Brazil's public debt, state finances, state-owned companies, electricity prices, its major physical assets, and the cyberattacks of 2026 worldwide. Includes a daily briefing and a topic explainer.
